situation: Two firms negotiating a joint technical standard — both openly pledge to adopt it, and the venture only pays off if both actually follow through; walking back a public commitment is embarrassing and costly

players.name: PlatformX
players.note: Wants the shared standard, will follow if the other does

players.name: PlatformY
players.note: Conditional cooperator, coordinates on a credible pledge

rationale.R: both adopt the shared standard = the market coordinates, best outcome
rationale.T: defect to a proprietary stack while they adopt = short-term edge, smaller than the shared win
rationale.S: adopt while they defect = stranded investment
rationale.w: the standard window lasts a year or two
rationale.noise: a delayed commit misread as backing out
rationale.cheapTalk: credibility = how much a public pledge is believed and coordinated on; lieCost = the reputational/embarrassment cost of publicly pledging to adopt and then not
